# StrataScratch

> > StrataScratch is a comprehensive data science interview preparation platform offering SQL and Python coding challenges, interview guides, and technical tutorials.

The platform provides hands-on practice problems, company-specific interview guides (Airbnb, Meta, DoorDash), and educational content covering SQL, Python, statistics, and machine learning. Founded by data science educators including Nathan Rosidi, StrataScratch helps aspiring data scientists and analysts prepare for technical interviews through real-world coding challenges and detailed tutorials.

## Key Topics

- Data Science Interviews
- SQL Interview Questions
- Python Programming
- Interview Preparation
- Statistics & Probability
- NumPy & Pandas
- SQL Window Functions
- Product Analyst Interviews
- Machine Learning Concepts
- Coding Best Practices
- Company Interview Guides (Airbnb, Meta, DoorDash)
- Algorithm Complexity
- Data Science Projects
- Career Development

- [30 Product Analyst Interview Questions](https://www.stratascratch.com/blog/30-product-analyst-interview-questions): 30 product analyst interview questions across 7 topic categories

- [Solving LeetCode Word Break Problem for Data Science Interviews](https://www.stratascratch.com/blog/solving-leetcode-word-break-problem-for-data-science-interviews): LeetCode Word Break problem solution for data science interviews
